description: Change a Pulse check: its name, what it watches, how often and from where it runs, when it alerts, or which channels it alerts. Only the fields you pass are changed; the type cannot change. A shorter interval or more locations uses more runs: dry_run returns the new runs and cost a month.

alert_after.description: Failures in a row, from one location, that open an incident: 1 to 10, default 2

channel_ids.description: Alert channels to tell when it fails and recovers (ids from edge_list_pulse_channels). Without one, nobody is told.

config.description: Settings beyond the target, merged over it; needed for api checks. http: method, headers, body, followRedirects, expectStatus (list of codes), bodyContains, expectHeaders, verifyTls. dns: recordType, resolver, expectValues. ssl: port, serverName. tcp and udp: send, expect. ping: count. api: steps (list of { url, method, headers, body, expectStatus, bodyContains, assertJson, extract }) and variables.

degraded_ms.description: A passing run slower than this is marked slow: 1 to 60000

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

interval_sec.description: Seconds between runs (default 60; browser 300 and ssl 3600, which are also their shortest). Each run from each location counts against the 150,000 free runs a month.

location_count.description: How many locations it runs from, chosen by Pulse and spread across regions: 1 to 20, default 3

location_ids.description: Run from these locations only (ids from edge_list_pulse_locations), instead of location_count

recover_after.description: Passes in a row before a location counts as recovered: 1 to 10, default 2

target.description: What to watch, in one line. http and browser: a URL. dns: "example.com" or "example.com MX". ssl: "example.com" or "example.com:8443". tcp and udp: "db.example.com:5432". ping: a host.

timeout_ms.description: How long a run may take: 1000 to 30000, default 10000 (browser: 5000 to 60000, default 30000)

name: edge_update_pulse_check
